title: Chainweb SLH-DSA signature verification vectors (KIP-0041)
messageFraming: M' = 0x01 || len(context) || context || DER(hashAlgOid) || hash  (FIPS 205 section 10.2.2)

encoding.cmd: UTF-8 string; hash = BLAKE2b-256(cmd) over the exact bytes shown
encoding.hash: hex, 32 bytes (the Chainweb transaction hash; base64url on the wire)
encoding.signature: base64url without padding (RFC 4648 section 5), 7856 bytes / 10475 chars for SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s

keyDerivation: seed = BLAKE2b(seedLabel, 48 bytes); keygen per FIPS 205 slh_keygen_internal with SK.seed = seed[0:16], SK.prf = seed[16:32], PK.seed = seed[32:48]
signatureDerivation: hedged signing per FIPS 205 slh_sign_internal with addrnd = BLAKE2b(entropyLabel, 16 bytes)

testGroups.description: Binding. Valid signatures must verify; manipulated inputs must be rejected. A disagreement means the two implementations are not interoperable.

tests.name: V1
tests.description: Valid signature over a coin.transfer command with a q: signer and capabilities

tests.name: V2
tests.description: Valid signature over a coin.transfer-create command with a q keyset, same key as V1

tests.name: V3
tests.description: Valid signature over non-JSON content: the verifier only sees the BLAKE2b-256 hash
tests.cmd: Verificacion cruzada Koberlet PQ - caso V3: el verificador no interpreta el contenido, solo su hash blake2b-256.

tests.name: V4
tests.description: Valid signature over an empty command (hash of the empty string)

tests.name: V5
tests.description: Valid signature over multibyte UTF-8 content (accents, ñ, kanji): catches text-encoding mismatches

tests.name: N1
tests.description: Signature of V1 with one bit flipped in the first byte

tests.name: N2
tests.description: Signature of V1 with one bit flipped in the last byte

tests.name: N3
tests.description: Valid signature of V1 presented against the hash of V2

tests.name: N4
tests.description: Public key of V3 with the hash and signature of V1

tests.name: N5
tests.description: Signature of V1 truncated to 7855 bytes (one byte short)

tests.name: N6
tests.description: Hash of V1 truncated to 31 bytes (length not defined by KIP-0041)

tests.name: N7
tests.description: Public key of V1 truncated to 31 bytes

tests.name: N8
tests.description: Public key of V1 with one byte changed (same length, different key)

testGroups.description: Encoding conformance. The signature bytes are the valid signature of V1; only the textual encoding changes. KIP-0041 mandates unpadded base64url, so a conforming decoder rejects any "=".

tests.name: C1
tests.description: Valid signature of V1 encoded with one trailing "=" (10476 chars). KIP-0041 requires unpadded base64url: must be rejected

tests.name: C2
tests.description: Valid signature of V1 encoded with two trailing "==" (10477 chars). Must be rejected
